title: Billing Executive
description:
Company Description Sanya Pharma Pvt Ltd is a key part of a family-owned group that began in 1960 with Medicine House, one of the first pharmaceutical wholesalers in Patna, Bihar, focused on providing life-saving medicines to the state. Over the decades, the group has evolved into a leading supply chain and distribution partner for major Pharma and FMCG companies across Bihar and Jharkhand. As a trusted channel partner, Sanya Pharma Pvt Ltd delivers resilient supply chain infrastructure and a professional work culture to its associates. The company operates as a C&FA and state distributor (super stockist), offering services, IT systems, facilities, and management support. Its long-term partnerships are built on trust, transparent communication, responsiveness, and a shared strategic vision.
Role Description The Billing Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Patna. The Billing Executive will be responsible for preparing and processing invoices, verifying billing data, and ensuring accuracy in customer and vendor accounts. Daily tasks include coordinating with internal teams and external partners to resolve billing discrepancies, updating financial records, and maintaining organized documentation. The role also involves monitoring payment status, following up on outstanding bills, and supporting finance and accounting teams with reports and reconciliations. The Billing Executive is expected to adhere to company policies and regulatory requirements while contributing to efficient, reliable billing operations.
Qualifications
  • Candidates should possess strong Billing Process and Invoicing skills, with attention to accuracy and compliance.
  • Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to review data, identify discrepancies, and support reconciliations.
  • Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, and customers.
  • Candidates should possess basic to intermediate Finance knowledge, particularly in billing, accounts receivable, and documentation.
  • Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office or similar tools, and familiarity with billing or ERP software.
  • Candidates should possess strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle high volumes of transactions.
  • Candidates should possess a minimum of a diploma or bachelorâs degree in commerce, finance, accounting, or a related field; prior experience in pharmaceutical or FMCG distribution billing is an advantage.
